nationwide.label: Nationwide Operations
nationwide.title: Based in Kyiv. Supporting clients across Ukraine.
nationwide.intro: From our Kyiv-based operations, we store corporate equipment and coordinate dispatch, collection and returns for employees, offices and project sites across Ukraine, wherever carrier services are available.

points.title: Nationwide Dispatch
points.text: Equipment deliveries wherever courier services are available.

points.title: Collection & Returns

points.title: Storage & Stock Records

abroad.title: Managing Ukraine from abroad?
abroad.text: Keep control of your equipment while we arrange storage and physical operations locally — through one English-speaking point of contact, without needing to run your own warehouse in Ukraine.
